source: dialogue_14093 (resource 2815020, Master Asia / Master Gundam victory line): "...Sore zo touzai-nanboku, chuuou-fuhai! Suupaa Ajia no chikara yo!"
why: Master Asia's own self-mocking pun name, playing on his title 'Undefeated of the East' (Touhou Fuhai) by claiming to be undefeated in every direction (touzai-nanboku, chuuou-fuhai = east-west-south-north, center) and therefore 'Super Asia'. Not present in character_names_021.json, unit_names_014_a/b.json, or encyclopedia_022.json. Proposing a literal transliteration ('Super Asia') since it is a wordplay name rather than a title with an established alternate English rendering; recommend the orchestrator confirm against the G Gundam wiki/dub if this line is ever revisited for polish.
